Hi Amira / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and what we can provide immediately: 

SOC 2: 
- Current status: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II audit cycle covering our serving runtime and control environment; we have an internal report and an external auditor report in final review.
- Estimated availability: full SOC 2 Type II report expected to be available for sharing under NDA by 2026-06-30.

Incident response / breach notification: 
- Policy: For confirmed incidents involving personal data, Redwood commits to notify impacted customers within 72 hours of discovery and will provide a written incident report that includes timeline, scope, mitigation steps, and remediation plan.
- Operational incidents that do not involve personal data are typically communicated via customer success within 7 business days or as part of regular incident summaries.
- Evidence: attached is our incident-response-playbook.pdf (redacted for public distribution) and a one-page IR summary. We can provide more detailed artifacts under NDA or via a secured transfer.

BCP / DR: 
- RTO/RPO: Our typical customer-facing default RTO is 4 hours for production inference endpoints and RPO is 1 hour for stateful KV caches; we document customer-specific targets in dedicated agreements.
- DR test evidence: We can share DR test summaries and executive sign-offs; attached: dr-bcp-summary.pdf

Vendor questionnaire intake: 
- Please send the spreadsheet link to marissa_cole@redwood.com. She will own intake and provide initial pre-fill for common items. For anything that requires security-only answers, I'll respond directly.

Attachments included in this message: incident-response-playbook.pdf, dr-bcp-summary.pdf, redwood-security-brief.pdf
